ladder.note: 158 nights, one bet each, priced from the books' real X+ rung prices (ESPN BET closing lines, margin removed) and turned into the odds Winamax is expected to pay.
ladder.verdict: The bets landed 84 of 158 (53%) against 83.5 stated: honest chances, +9.2 units at 1 unit a night, best climb 11 levels. Priced from the exact rung, twice as many picks fell inside 2.00-2.10 as when the price was carried from the main line (which was about break-even, -4.0).
